qualification.details: Domain Expert - Procurement: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, Law, Finance, Economics, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline. Minimum 60% marks. Minimum three years hands-on experience in procurement, tendering, contract management. Working knowledge of GeM, CPP Portal, NIC e-Procurement. Understanding of GFR, Procurement Manuals, MSME, Make in India. Consultant: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, AI, Data Science, ML, Electronics, Electrical, Mathematics, Statistics or related. Minimum 60% marks. Minimum five years professional experience in AI/ML, NLP, LLMs, SLMs or enterprise AI-system development. Hands-on in at least three of: SLM/LLM training, NLP, RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation. Working knowledge of Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain. Project Manager: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, CS, IT, AI, Data Science, Electronics, Electrical, Business Administration, Project Management or related. Minimum 60% marks. Minimum ten years experience in managing software, AI/ML, digital transformation, IT projects. Proven experience in at least two end-to-end technology projects. Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall. Experience with Jira, MS Project, Trello, Asana, Azure DevOps. Software Quality Assurance Engineer – Automation & API Testing: Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Applications or related. Minimum 60% marks. Minimum two years hands-on in software testing, QA automation, web/API testing. Practical experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress. Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, TypeScript. Experience with Postman, REST, PyTest, Jira, Bugzilla, TestRail, Azure DevOps. Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum, SDLC, CI/CD.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 12 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Domain Expert - Procurement post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Domain Expert - Procurement post at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Domain Expert - Procurement role?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, Law, Finance, Economics, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline with a minimum of 60% marks is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the experience required for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: A minimum of five years of professional experience in AI/ML, NLP, LLMs, SLMs, or enterprise AI-system development is required for the Consultant position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Manager position is Rs. 2,00,000 + 20% HRA + Medical as per norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Assam.
